- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network, open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). On the first visit you take the root certificate, and then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX** — I can have my own accounts, so you can write and call me there; also my own Messenger and Instagram.
